text:
aisha: Short GA sync 4: checklist: SLA wording, monitoring coverage, docs publish, support rota, pricing safety knobs. Need owners + dates.
maya: PM: high-level launch constraints: no breaking API changes, docs live, billing caps in place. We should freeze swagger by Thu.
ben: Infra check: perf runs show p95=90ms, p99=480ms at baseline load. Canary needed for longer tail behavior. Also need explicit SLA clause for maintenance windows.
carmen: SRE: can own 99.9% uptime for the API. We want a clear statement about scheduled maintenance and guaranteed notice window (48h). Error budget policy: alert at 20% daily burn, page at 40%.
shira: Legal: I will produce the SLA legal paragraph. Need final metrics and exceptions from SRE by Wed EOD.
diego: Docs: I'll publish GA guide draft tomorrow. Need final pricing table and the canned support responses. Will include a "known issues" section.
elena: Support: tier1 triage playbook ready. For GA week we'll staff extended hours and a triage lead. Need runbook links and KB URLs.
farah: Billing: recommend default per-account burst cap and a soft-warning at 75% spend. Also propose emergency spending lockdown toggle for customers. Need wording for pricing page and API quota docs.
aisha: Monitoring: must cover synthetic checks for /health, /predict, embedding endpoints. All alerts must include runbook link and severity. @ben can you add runbook_url field?
ben: Will add runbook_url and include service, route, and runbook. Also enabling synthetic checks every 1m for critical paths.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout initiated at 5% traffic. Health checks green for 30m.
carmen: Rollout policy proposal: 5% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100%. Stability gate 1h at each stage, manual proceed if alerts are clean. Auto-rollback if error rate +1% absolute or p95 > 2x baseline.
diego: Docs snippet I'll add: ```GA Guide
- Quickstart
- SLA summary
- Pricing & quotas
- Runbooks & KB
- Rollback steps```
maya: Decision needed: lock GA for Monday 14:00 UTC or move by 48h if Legal SLA not signed. Any objections?
shira: If Legal has SLA text by Wed EOD, Monday is fine. Otherwise push 48h.
farah: Also need finance sign-off on billing cap copy and telemetry to support quota alerts; ETA Thu noon.
ben: Technical tasks: add graceful-degradation path for heavy KV misses, add unit + integration tests. I'll open PRs by Thu.
carmen: I'll schedule an incident drill for week 2 post-GA and circulate the runbook.
elena: I'll prepare canned responses and escalation ladder and attach to the docs for the first month.
aisha: Action items: Legal SLA text (shira) Wed EOD; Pricing copy & cap (farah) Thu 12:00; Docs publish (diego) Thu 18:00; SRE gating policy (carmen) Thu EOD. I'll consolidate and send final checklist to execs tomorrow morning.
maya: Noted. If all owners hit deadlines we can proceed with Monday 14:00 UTC GA. :tada:
